objective: Bound official-sample settlement retries by attempts and monotonic wall-clock budget, preserve DATA_BLOCKED before the nightly subprocess timeout, and bind both producer and orchestrator to one shared timeout fact source.
non_goals: Do not run the live nightly, fetch market data, or write production ledgers
Do not change the 20:30 scheduler, publication authority, target-date authority, or sample methodology
Do not retry authentication, transport, API, schema, or generic SystemExit failures
Do not convert missing or late settlement evidence into success or reuse a prior date
input_contracts: Tushare close/settlement source dates from moneyflow_dc, daily and index_daily
SettlementDateMismatch as the only retryable failure
One shared nightly subprocess timeout constant consumed by the orchestrator and official-sample budget validation
output_artifacts: Whole-snapshot retries bounded by six attempts and a 420-second monotonic wait budget
DATA_BLOCKED with no sample/log write when dates remain inconsistent or regress
Shared 600-second nightly subprocess timeout with at least 120 seconds reserved beyond the wait budget
Offline regressions and mutation cases proving actual runner/producer timeout binding
